Overview

Fully integrated
environments for human
performance.

HPC delivers fully integrated environments designed to optimize performance, recovery, and longevity. Each technology is intentionally selected to enhance cellular health, physical output, and long-term vitality.

We provide end-to-end consultation, installation, operational, and ongoing support. No two HPC environments are identical. Every engagement begins with the client’s specific goals, space, and budget.

Part One

Fundamental performance,
recovery & longevity technologies

Twenty flagship modalities. The backbone of every HPC installation, from private residence to clinical-grade facility. Each system is selected for clinical validity, operational reliability, and outcomes clients can feel and measure.

01

Pulse PEMF — Pulse XL Pro PEMF System

High-intensity pulsed electromagnetic field system from Pulse PEMF (formerly Pulse Centers), a long-standing name in whole-body PEMF “Cellular Exercise.” The flagship Pulse XL Pro pairs solid-state engineering with user-adjustable pulse rate and field strength, and powers two accessories at once for full-body and targeted sessions. PEMF is designed to support circulation, cellular energy, and recovery of muscles, joints, and connective tissue by working with the body’s natural repair processes.

02

Dialed Labs — Saunas + Cold Plunges

Premium home sauna and cold plunge systems engineered for contrast therapy, from the Official Sauna & Cold Plunge Equipment of the UFC. The range spans full-spectrum infrared Smart saunas and pods with integrated red light, plus outdoor traditional and barrel saunas with Harvia heaters, all built from oil-treated spruce hemlock with Wi-Fi app control. Self-contained, plumbing-free cold plunges reach 37°F and below, with advanced filtration and, on select models, UV and ozone purification. Individual units and paired configurations available.

03

NanoVi — Protein Repair & Oxidative Stress System

Bio-identical signaling technology from Seattle-based Eng3 that reproduces the signal the body uses to repair damage from oxidative stress. By influencing the water surrounding proteins, NanoVi is designed to support protein folding and repair, improving cellular resilience. Research, including placebo-controlled studies, reports protection of protein function, stronger antioxidant defenses, fewer DNA double-strand breaks, and measurable changes in markers such as heart rate variability. Available in Exo, Pro, and Eco models; studies available upon request.

04

Therabody — Theragun + JetBoots Recovery Suite

Percussive therapy and wireless pneumatic compression systems designed to improve circulation, speed muscle recovery, and reduce soreness. The suite pairs Theragun PRO Plus devices, which add heat and other recovery modes to deep percussive massage, with JetBoots PRO Plus compression boots that combine compression, vibration, and infrared LED light. Highly portable for immediate post-training or post-procedure recovery support, and used by professional athletes and sports organizations globally.

05

HPO TECH — Hyperbaric Oxygen Chamber (2.0–2.4 ATA)

Hard-shell hyperbaric oxygen chamber from HPO TECH, a certified manufacturer whose chambers carry CE/EU MDR and ASME PVHO credentials. At 2.0–2.4 ATA, breathing pure oxygen dissolves significantly more oxygen into the plasma, helping it reach tissues with limited blood supply, including tendons, cartilage, and ligaments. Designed to support healing and recovery, it is a cornerstone of elite athletic and post-surgical recovery protocols worldwide.

06

ARRC LED — The Elysium Device™ Light Therapy Bed

Full-body photobiomodulation bed from ARRC LED, a U.S. manufacturer of LED light therapy systems since 1996. The Elysium Device delivers six wavelengths spanning green, red, and near-infrared light (530–940 nm), with high-frequency pulsing and integrated PEMF. Four built-in bioenergetic scans, interpreted by AI, guide resonant frequency protocols tailored to each session. Designed to support mitochondrial energy production, cellular repair, skin rejuvenation, and nervous system balance in clinical and private residential settings.

07

Stratosphere ATC — Hypobaric Altitude Training Chamber

Flagship altitude training chamber delivering true hypobaric hypoxia, with fully programmable simulated altitudes from sea level to 33,000 feet. Rapid, controlled pressure oscillations are designed to trigger deep adaptation across performance, recovery, and brain health, including HIF-1α activation and improved oxygen utilization. Protocols are backed by Mayo Clinic physiologist Dr. Bruce Johnson, and the chamber is built to the ASME PVHO-1 pressure-vessel standard. Used by elite athletes including LeBron James, with custom installation for private and institutional facilities.

08

CVAC — Hypobaric Conditioning Pod

Patented Cyclic Variations in Adaptive Conditioning (CVAC) pod that uses rapid, computer-controlled changes in air pressure, and the resulting shifts in oxygen availability and temperature, to drive adaptation at the cellular level. A typical 20-minute seated session cycles hundreds of times between simulated altitude and sea level. Designed to support EPO production, oxygen utilization, mitochondrial efficiency, and recovery, the CVAC pod has been used by elite athletes including Novak Djokovic. A more compact and accessible alternative to full altitude chambers.

09

The Cloud — Mineral Vapor Therapy System

Hydrogen-based mineral vapor therapy system that produces a fine, warm steam infused with molecular hydrogen and 77 trace minerals, breathed in and absorbed through the skin. Most often integrated into a steam shower, The Cloud turns a daily routine into a restorative session designed to support cellular hydration, respiratory comfort, relaxation, and recovery, with molecular hydrogen valued for its selective antioxidant properties. An elegant and highly differentiated wellness installation for premium private environments.

10

HOCATT — Ozone Sauna System

Multi-modality wellness chamber that combines transdermal ozone steam, carbonic acid (CO₂), far-infrared heat, high-intensity PEMF, frequency-specific microcurrent, ultraviolet irradiation, photon color light therapy, exercise with oxygen breathing, whole-body hyperthermia, and essential oil infusion, all at once. HOCATT integrates ten technologies in a single 30-minute session, and is offered in HOCATT and HOCATT PRO configurations for clinical and private use.

11

LongevityLabs — Ozone Sauna

Ozone sauna system delivering transdermal ozone therapy in a heated steam cabinet, paired with an ozone generator and medical oxygen source. Ozone, generated from pure oxygen, is designed to support detoxification, circulation, immune balance, and cellular oxygenation. Ozone has been used in integrative and longevity medicine for decades. A clean, elegant standalone modality for any serious performance or wellness environment.

12

QCell³ — Bioenergetic System

Integrated bioenergetic scanning and frequency platform that pairs AI-assisted analysis with targeted frequency sessions. The QCell³ maps the body’s bioenergetic patterns, highlights areas of energetic stress, and applies customized frequency protocols designed to restore energetic coherence and support relaxation and recovery. Drawing on the frequency work of Nikola Tesla and Royal Raymond Rife, it is used in integrative and bioenergetic wellness practices.

13

Equiscope — Electro-Equiscope System

The Electro-Equiscope is an FDA-registered Class II adaptive microcurrent system that uses real-time bioimpedance feedback to scan the body and adjust its output in milliseconds. Small plates and probes deliver gentle microcurrents through the skin in a drug-free, non-invasive session designed to support pain relief, inflammation reduction, and tissue recovery. Sessions typically run 30 to 90 minutes under the supervision of a licensed practitioner, and the system is used in both human and equine rehabilitation.

14

Keiser — Pneumatic Performance Equipment

Air-powered resistance training systems engineered for strength, speed, power development, and rehabilitation with minimal joint strain. Because pneumatic resistance carries almost none of the inertia and momentum of iron, Keiser machines load muscles smoothly at any speed, and resistance can be adjusted mid-set at the touch of a button. The A300 and A400 lines suit explosive athletic training, post-injury reconditioning, and active-aging programs alike, and are used by professional and collegiate teams worldwide.

15

Echo — Hydrogen Water, Plunge & Whole-Home Systems

Echo Water brings molecular hydrogen to every point of water contact in the home. Under-counter and countertop machines such as the Echo One, Echo Ultimate, and Echo H2 deliver filtered, hydrogen-rich water on tap through dedicated faucets, while the Echo Flask makes fresh hydrogen water on the go. The Echo Revive infuses baths and plunges with dissolved hydrogen, and the Echo Whole Home Water Filter treats every tap and shower. Molecular hydrogen is a selective antioxidant studied for its role in hydration, recovery, and cellular health.

16

Axis Saunas — Hybrid Infrared + Traditional Sauna

Axis by Symmetry is a premium pre-built sauna line from the team behind Symmetry Sauna. The Axis Hybrid, formerly the Fusion, pairs ultra-low-EMF far- and mid-infrared panels with a Harvia or HUUM stone heater, so one cabin offers a gentle infrared session or a classic 155–194°F Finnish sauna with water-to-stone steam. It is finished in Western red cedar with a black thermo-aspen exterior, two-tier benching, chromotherapy lighting, and Wi-Fi control, and comes in 4×4 and 4×6 sizes.

17

BioCharger — Subtle Energy Platform

The BioCharger NG combines four natural energies, light, PEMF, pulsed electric fields, and harmonic frequencies, in a touchless 15-minute seated session. Users simply sit near the device while it runs one of more than 1,400 guided programs designed to support recovery, sleep, energy, and calm. Used by athletes, biohackers, and longevity practitioners at home and in professional settings, it counts Tony Robbins among its best-known advocates.

18

ARX — Adaptive Resistance Exercise System

Motor-driven adaptive resistance system that matches a user’s exact force on every repetition, loading both the lifting and lowering phases that conventional weights cannot fully challenge. Software tracks total and peak force, range of motion, and fatigue rep by rep. ARX delivers a measured full-body workout in about 15 minutes, or as little as six, across the guided-sled ARX Alpha and the cable-driven ARX Omni, making it well suited to time-constrained executives, rehabilitation, and longevity-focused strength training.

19

Vasper — Compression + Cooling Exercise System

Patented exercise system, developed in research with NASA, that integrates compression, cooling, and interval training into a single 21-minute low-impact protocol. While the user pedals and pulls at a comfortable effort, cooled compression cuffs on the arms and legs concentrate lactic acid in the working muscles, a signal designed to stimulate growth hormone and other anabolic hormones. Vasper reports that each session delivers the training effect of up to two hours of high-intensity exercise, with three sessions a week recommended.

20

OxeFit — AI-Powered Strength System

AI-powered training platform that combines robotic, computer-controlled resistance with an integrated force plate and motion sensors. OxeFit adjusts load in real time, with modes such as eccentric overload, accommodating resistance, and perturbation, while the force plate detects asymmetries in balance and output. The XS1 adds rowing, SkiCross, and other cardio modes plus Pilates to a library of 280+ exercises, and the professional-grade XP1 offers loads up to 500 pounds for elite and team settings.

Part Two

Intelligent add-ons

Fourteen supplementary systems that complete an HPC environment. The details that compound — sleep optimization, circadian lighting, grounding, water and air infrastructure, daily-use tools, diagnostics, and cognitive performance.

A

Eight Sleep — Pod Sleep System

The Eight Sleep Pod is an intelligent mattress cover that cools and heats each side of the bed independently, paired with a compact Hub and app. Built-in sensors track sleep stages, heart rate, HRV, and breathing rate without a wearable, and Autopilot adjusts temperature through the night based on that data. The current Pod 6 adds a smaller Hub, faster temperature response, and more biometric sensors. Bryan Johnson uses the Pod daily as part of his Blueprint longevity protocol.

B

BEMER — Physical Vascular Therapy

FDA-cleared Class II device that delivers a low-intensity pulsed electromagnetic field with a patented signal structure, designed to stimulate muscles and temporarily increase local blood flow and microcirculation. Supporting better oxygen delivery to tissues, the protocol takes just eight minutes, twice a day, using a full-body mat or targeted pads. Developed with German engineering and Swiss craftsmanship, BEMER is used in integrative practices, athletic recovery programs, and at home.

C

RAY Lighting — Circadian-Friendly Lighting

Circadian-friendly LED lighting engineered to come as close as possible to natural sunlight. RAY’s BlueBalance technology removes the blue spike found in standard LEDs, Flicker Free Bridging Technology reduces flicker to virtually zero, and a full-spectrum phosphor achieves a color rendering index of up to 98. Available as retrofit bulbs, spotlights, and accent fittings in the SunRAY and Dynamic X ranges, RAY is designed to support natural sleep-wake rhythms, mood, and visual comfort.

D

Ra Optics — Circadian Eyewear & Lighting

Precision light-filtering eyewear and circadian-friendly lighting designed to align daily light exposure with the body’s natural rhythms. Ra Optics lenses are developed for specific times of day — Daylight for indoor screen use, BlueSync for time outdoors, and Sunset, which blocks more than 99% of blue light, for the evening wind-down — supporting deeper sleep and reduced eye strain. Lumios bulbs, offered in Glow, Sky, and Candle versions, extend the same principle to the home.

E

BON CHARGE — Circadian & Blue-Free Lighting

Circadian-friendly lighting designed to keep the home in step with natural light. BON CHARGE’s blue-free bulbs, lamps, clip lights, and plug-in and motion-sensor night lights cast a warm, low-blue glow for evenings, while its full-spectrum bulbs and lamps bring brighter, daylight-like light to daytime spaces. Together they help create sleep-friendly evenings and clear, energizing days. The range is complemented by blue-light-blocking eyewear and a line of red light therapy devices.

F

Earthing — Grounding Technology

Grounding products that connect the body to the Earth’s natural electrical charge through a home’s grounded outlet while sleeping, working, or relaxing indoors. The Earthing range includes mattress covers, sleep mats, pillow covers, universal mats, and yoga mats, building on the grounding principles introduced by Clint Ober. Grounding has been studied for its effects on sleep quality, stress, circulation, and recovery. A simple, passive daily practice that works while you rest.

G

Ophora — Water Filtration & Oxygen Soaks

Ultra-premium water purification and oxygenation delivering clean, hyper-oxygenated water at every tap. Ophora’s Nano-Pure filtration is designed to remove heavy metals, chlorine, fluoride, pharmaceuticals, and microplastics before the water is enriched with dissolved oxygen. The same technology powers Ophora’s wellness soaks — chlorine-free spa vessels and pools kept clean with stabilized oxygen, ozone, and UV rather than chemicals. Available as countertop and under-counter stations, whole-home and estate systems, wellness spas, and pools.

H

O3 Waterworks — Ozone Laundry & Cleaning System

Chemical-free cleaning powered by ozonated water. The O3 Smart Laundry System connects to the washer’s cold-water line to clean, deodorize, and sanitize clothing and linens with little or no detergent, while a portable ozone spray bottle replaces conventional household cleaning sprays on counters, fabrics, and surfaces. Reduces the chemical load of the home environment without compromising cleanliness.

I

CopperWater — Ayurvedic Copper Hydration

Handcrafted, unlined copper water bottles and pitchers made by artisans in India from 99.7–99.9% pure copper. Drinking from copper vessels is rooted in Ayurveda, a system of natural healing more than 4,000 years old, and copper’s natural antimicrobial properties have long been valued for keeping stored water fresh. Traditionally associated with digestion and immune support, it is an elegant daily hydration upgrade for the home, office, and travel.

J

Air Filtration — IQAir + Jaspr

Medical-grade air purification for every room. IQAir’s Swiss-made HyperHEPA systems capture particles down to 0.003 microns, including ultrafine particles, allergens, and pollutants, while the Jaspr Air Scrubber pairs a heavy-duty 3-in-1 filter with activated carbon and real-time PM2.5 and VOC sensors in a steel, home-designed housing. Cleaner indoor air supports respiratory health and sleep quality and reduces exposure to mold, wildfire smoke, and VOCs.

K

BrainTap — Neural Optimization Headset

Guided relaxation headset combining an LED light visor, layered audio with binaural beats and tones, and guided visualization to help the brain shift into calmer, more focused states. Sessions are delivered through the BrainTap app and are designed to ease stress, support restful sleep, and sharpen mental clarity. A wireless, foldable design makes the practice easy to take anywhere, from a midday reset to an evening wind-down.

L

Rapid Release — Pro3+ Vibration Therapy

High-frequency vibration therapy device used by chiropractors, physical therapists, massage therapists, and athletic trainers to address muscle tension, stiffness, and restricted mobility. The cordless Rapid Release Pro3+ uses a patented short-stroke orbital vibration at roughly 10,000 vibrations per minute — three to five times faster than percussion massagers — delivering focused stimulation without a hammering stroke. It is registered as an FDA Class I medical device.

M

InBody — 770S Body Composition Analyzer

Professional-grade bioelectrical impedance analyzer delivering detailed body composition results in about 30 seconds. The InBody 770S reports segmental lean mass and body fat, body fat percentage, total body water with extracellular-to-total water ratio, visceral fat, and whole-body phase angle as a marker of cellular health. Trusted by hospitals, research institutions, and professional sports organizations worldwide.

N

Ping Pong Table — Cognitive Performance Addition

Premium performance-lifestyle addition supporting hand-eye coordination, reaction time, bilateral motor skills, and social engagement. Table tennis combines aerobic movement with fast decision-making and strategy, engaging multiple brain regions at once. It has been studied as an activity to support cognitive health in older adults, with a growing body of research exploring its benefits for people with Alzheimer’s and dementia.
